boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain SUNY Maritime College
boards.description: Ten documented food-and-coffee destinations with evening or overnight hours, including the on-campus café and sites in Throggs Neck and the eastern Bronx.

cards.title: SeaWolves Café
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, SUNY Maritime College
cards.notes: Check the café schedule before heading over; the college guide lists made-to-order sandwiches, salads, grill items, pizza, snacks, and coffee.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus café with documented evening service during fall and spring semesters.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s 2025–26 guide lists SeaWolves Café hours as 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Thursday during fall and spring semesters.
cards.access_notes: Documented 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday in fall and spring; summer hours are limited and operational hours may change.

cards.title: Charleys Cheesesteaks – Throggs Neck
cards.subtitle: 815 Hutchinson River Pkwy #2, Bronx
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm the day’s closing time and place an order; this counter-service location lists sandwiches, fries, wings, drinks, and desserts.
cards.short_summary: A Throggs Neck food option with nightly service listed through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Charleys’ official Throggs Neck page lists 11 a.m.–9 p.m. hours Monday through Saturday and noon–8 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists closing at 9 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 8 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza – E Tremont Ave
cards.subtitle: 3706 E Tremont Ave, Bronx
cards.notes: Check the store page immediately before ordering; it provides the location-specific menu and directs customers to its current hours section.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza chain location whose official page shows service until 1 a.m. today.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 3706 E Tremont Ave identifies the Bronx store and displays it as open until 1:00 a.m. today.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 3706 E Tremont Ave
cards.access_notes: Official store page displayed “Open Today Until 1:00 AM” when fetched; verify the live Hours section for the selected day.

cards.title: Dunkin' at BP Gas Station
cards.subtitle: 4147 Throggs Neck Expy, Bronx
cards.notes: Use mobile ordering or stop at the BP Gas Station location; verify the day’s posted close before making a late coffee or snack run.
cards.short_summary: A Throggs Neck coffee-and-donut stop listed until 11 p.m. most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin’s official location page lists 4 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Saturday and 5 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists an 11 p.m. close Monday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Patricia's Pizza of Tremont
cards.subtitle: 3883 E Tremont Ave, Bronx
cards.notes: Open the restaurant’s order page and select pickup or delivery, then consult its live hours control before leaving campus for the Tremont Avenue address.
cards.short_summary: A named E Tremont Avenue pizzeria with direct pickup and delivery ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Patricia’s official ordering page identifies Patricia's Pizza of Tremont at 3883 E Tremont Ave and provides pickup, delivery, and hours controls.
cards.access_notes: The official page provides a live Hours control; confirm the current closing time before going.

cards.title: Wendy's – Tremont Ave
cards.subtitle: 2703 E Tremont Ave, Bronx
cards.notes: Confirm whether you need restaurant, drive-thru, or delivery service, then use the posted location schedule; the site lists late hours every day.
cards.short_summary: An eastern-Bronx Wendy’s with restaurant and drive-thru hours extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists this location open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4:59 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are listed through 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy's – Westchester Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2140 Westchester Ave, Bronx
cards.notes: Check the location’s live schedule and choose restaurant, drive-thru, or delivery as available; its official page lists late closing times across the week.
cards.short_summary: A Westchester Avenue fast-food location with documented service past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday and Saturday for this restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are listed until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy's – Boston Road
cards.subtitle: 3636 Boston Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Use the official Bronx locations page to check the day’s schedule before traveling; this named Boston Road restaurant is listed with late daily availability.
cards.short_summary: A Boston Road option listed open until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Bronx location listing identifies 3636 Boston Road and lists it as open until 3:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Wendy's locations in Bronx, New York
cards.access_notes: Official Bronx listing shows 3636 Boston Road open until 3:00 a.m. daily; confirm live hours before departure.

cards.title: Wendy's – Pelham/Boston
cards.subtitle: 4330 Boston Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Check the official location page shortly before going and use the listed restaurant or drive-thru service; holiday hours may vary at this location.
cards.short_summary: A Pelham-area Wendy’s with late restaurant and drive-thru hours documented by day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists this location open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are listed until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's – E Fordham Rd
cards.subtitle: 342 E Fordham Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Review the official schedule before traveling and select the service type that fits; the location page shows restaurant hours extending well beyond midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Fordham Road location with officially posted overnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists 6:30 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 6:30 a.m.–4:59 a.m. Friday, and 5 a.m.–4:59 a.m. Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official schedule lists service until 2:30 a.m. most weekdays and 4:59 a.m. Friday and Saturday; confirm the day’s live hours.

warnings: Hours are source-verified as of 2026-08-13 and can change; consult each direct location page before traveling.
